recovery: Restore valid canonical workflow from protected main parent; reinsert exact migration-only provider gate via literal-safe replacement; retain latest edge/website gates and add regression for trigger and unique workflow structure.
prevention: Use callback-based source replacements and release workflow structural assertions; do not mark PR terminal until GitHub workflow registration and dispatch readback.
